errors.evidence: The description incorrectly assigns orange to France and gray to China/Continental/, whereas the chart shows France in gray and China/Continental/ in orange.
The description incorrectly assigns light blue to Turkey, whereas the chart shows Turkey in light green.
The description does not explicitly state that the chart illustrates the vineyard area in thousands of hectares for different countries over the years 2013 to 2022.
The description does not mention that the values for each country remain constant over the years, as observed in the chart.
